$comment: Single source of truth for Uni's visual language. Base ramps come from the Nocturne design system (_ds/nocturne-*/styles.css); the `uni` block adds the semantic roles the tracker and patcher need, which Nocturne does not have. Never write a hex anywhere else — generate from here. See build-tokens.mjs.

font.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

metrics.$comment: Geometry the tracker projects with. Row height and column widths are load-bearing: they are what the view-model maps nanoticks onto.
metrics.$laneBarComment: The per-lane clip-local bar:beat readout. FIXED, and the element occupies it even when blank: measure() derives trackStride from offsetLeft and resize() early-returns unless (viewportHeight, columns, trackCount) changed, so a readout sized by its text would leave the stride stale and desynchronise the header, the hit test and the scroll clamp. 40px fits '128:7' at --font-size-gutter.
metrics.$spineComment: The arrangement's SPINE strip — the named spans the song is built out of — directly under the bar numbers. 17 matches rowHeight, so a section band reads as one row of the same grid everything else in this interface is on. axisHeight is the total the time axis occupies above the lanes, and it exists so the arrangement's heads, lanes, grid and clips can all read ONE value: the heads and the lanes being computed separately is how a lane strip ends up a strip-height out of step with the heads that name it, which the comment above .ar-heads records happening once already.
metrics.$minimapComment: 30, not the 16 this said until now. 16 was a guess predating the redesign; the design component lays the column out at flex 0 0 30px and every inset inside it (marks 4, viewport 1, playhead 0) is measured against the 29px content box that leaves.

base.$comment: Verbatim from Nocturne. Do not edit here; re-extract if the design system changes.

uni.$comment: Semantic roles. Each value is either a base reference (base.*) or a literal rgba — literals only where alpha is needed, because a ramp step cannot express translucency over an arbitrary ground.

surface.$offGridComment: Rows a lane does not have. Lanes share one row axis, so a 4-per-beat lane sits on every third row of a 12-per-beat axis; the rest belong to the triplet and sextuplet lanes. Recessed rather than merely empty, because an empty cell is one you can type into and these are not.

rule.$comment: Track borders are deliberately heavier than intra-track column rules — the review found eight single-column tracks read as one undifferentiated grid when they were the same weight.

clip.$comment: Clips span rows, so rails live OUTSIDE the recycled row band — see tracker.js.

track.$comment: Per-track tint so adjacent tracks read as separate. Eight hues on the Nocturne lightness scale, at 4% over the ground.

harmony.$comment: The harmony lane in the tracker. Two stops of one accent wash: the design fades a field left-to-right so the rows beneath still read.

minimap.$comment: The song-overview column. Its ground is its own value and not surface.trackerBg: the design recesses the column a step below the tracker (#14161f against #161826) so it reads as being outside the scrolled strip rather than the last thing in it. The other three are aliases, named so the renderer asks for a role rather than for the accent.

trackHue.$comment: A saturated hue per track, for clip rails and clip identity. Distinct from uni.track.tint, which is a 4%-alpha wash for the cell background — a rail needs to be findable across the width of the screen, and eight shades of the same accent are not.
